name: fight15-s28
title: Hosting defaults and this computer's in-match options on their own pages; the router row says what it opens

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToOptions
wait_ms 600
select_settings_page Network
wait_ms 450
select_settings_page Network:Basics
wait 3
activate ButtonNetworkAdvanced
wait 4
select_settings_page Network:Player
wait 4
video_mark hosting-page-host
assert_visible CheckboxNetworkToasts 0
assert_visible CheckboxNetworkPrediction 0
assert_visible CheckboxNetworkDiagnostics 0
focus RadioNetworkDelayAuto
wait_ms 300
assert_label LabelNetworkHostingHint Automatic sizes each player's delay from their ping; Fixed uses the frames below
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkHostingHint
focus TextNetworkIdleWait
wait_ms 300
assert_label LabelNetworkHostingHint Minutes an open lobby waits with nobody joining before it closes
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkHostingHint
focus TextNetworkPathHorizon
wait_ms 300
assert_label LabelNetworkHostingHint Ticks AI route searches may take; longer avoids pauses on slow machines, AI orders start later
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkHostingHint
focus CheckboxNetworkAutoRepair
wait_ms 300
assert_label LabelNetworkHostingHint A match that falls out of step reloads the host's copy on every machine
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkHostingHint
select_settings_page Network:Chat
wait 4
video_mark in-match-page-host
assert_label TabNetPageChat In match
assert_visible CheckboxNetworkToasts 1
assert_visible CheckboxNetworkPrediction 1
assert_visible CheckboxNetworkDiagnostics 1
assert_label LabelNetworkPredictionHint Your own units answer at once; the match confirms each move a moment later
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkPredictionHint
post_command ButtonBackToMainMenu
wait_ms 900
assert_screen MainScreen
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
wait_combo ComboHostScene Grasslands
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
assert_label CheckHostPortMap Ask my router to open the game port - players connect directly
assert_text_fits CheckHostPortMap
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/scene-end.json 120
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
